d2ec869aa2.q: What is the theme of the 2026 CAAP Conference and why was Mission Possible chosen?
d2ec869aa2.a: The theme Mission Possible came from the desire to center mission as the heart of everything the organization does. All agencies are mission-driven and work with mission-aligned organizations, so centering mission became important. The theme also aligns with constantly reminding people about how immensely capable and amazing they are.

73601347a8.q: What are the pre-conference sessions available at the 2026 CAAP Conference?
